dct_description_sm: Contains land patent records, dating back to the late 1700s, from the Bureau of Land Management Eastern States repository. Documents may be searched by patentee name, document number, document authority, land office, legal land description, county, document type, title transfer authority, or any combination.
Contributors: United States. Bureau of Land Management. Eastern States Office
Publication statement: [Springfield, Va. : U.S. Dept. of the Interior, Bureau of Land Management, Eastern States ; Washington, D.C.? : Supt. of Docs., U.S. G.P.O., distributor, 1993]
System requirements: MS-DOS computer system capable of using a CD-ROM drive; hard drive with at least 540 KB free (1 MB recommended); CD-ROM drive.
Title on container spine: General Land Office automated records, Florida.
dct_subject_sm: United States.--Bureau of Land Management.--Eastern States Office--Databases
dct_title_s: General Land Office automated records project Florida : pre-1908 homestead & cash entry patents
